normal.name: Dr. G. Power
normal.text: I really wish there were still single stick analogue joysticks that are NOT flightsticks. Something like the old Mach I and IIs. Really long throw that gives you pin accurate precision. For games like the arcade version of Food Fight they give you a level of control that a joypad, even with extensions, cannot give you. #retrogaming

normal.name: Raindrac
normal.text: I’m beginning to grow a fond appreciation for the GameCube now that I’m playing a lot of my old games on the Steam Deck. It’s just pure gaming! No gimmicks, dead servers or predatory micro-transactions. Everything just works. And it’s not as antiquated as games often are on older consoles, either, so it strikes a sweet spot that no other Nintendo console does. #gaming #retrogaming #gamecube #nintendo

normal.text: You enter the vicinity of what appears to be a rural mansion, or perhaps a town hall. Idyllic flower gardens and old-timey brick houses line the streets. Behind the mansion is a large flower garden with a fountain at the center. But there are also zombies roaming the streets, and you can't help noticing that the streets are also lined with numerous pillars topped with what appear to be statues of revenants and arch-viles. At least, you hope they're statues… #Doom #gaming #retrogaming
